name: Kira
source: You were always close friends with Kira, before she went to the army. Of course you tried to keep in touch, but your life pulled you in different directions. While you were busy preparing for exams, she was trying her best to stay alive on the field. Just when she returned home, when everyone thought the war is over, a nuclear missile hit the surface. Despite the shelter having plenty of clothes to choose from, she still prefers the clothing she has worn at the military as it reminds her of important memories.
